question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**varying**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"varying"(**परिवर्तनीय)** is the best choice** to put in place of** the blank number 5.**
 
• This is due to the fact that **people who are thinking about migrating have varied backgrounds**, special experiences, and traits that affect their decision-making.
 
• As a result, both their observed and unseen characteristics will differ, **resulting in various decisions and migratory patterns.**

 
• Example: *The **varying **shades of red looked so pretty.*
 
• Thus, the term** "varying" appropriately captures the variety of factors that affect migration** decisions as well as the variety of migratory patterns that emerge.

Correct Passage__: *Human migration may be traced all the way back to the (1) __dawn__ of time, and humans have been on the move ever since. Climate change, war and displacement, economic considerations, living conditions, family and clan (2) __ties__, and, more recently, educational possibilities are all reasons for migration. Because there are several reasons for migration, migration patterns are (3) __diverse__. Potential migrants will not only (4) __determine__ whether or not to migrate, but also where they will go. Individuals with **(5) __varying__** observed and unobserved features will make diverse decisions and self-select into specific areas.*
